statement: Between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-30, at least one Russian strike event in Kyiv city or Kyiv oblast kills 10 or more people according to Ukrainian state authorities.
resolution: Ukrainian state authorities attribute 10 or more deaths to a single strike event in Kyiv city or oblast occurring between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-30, carried by two international news agencies.
failure_condition: No single strike event in Kyiv city or oblast between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-30 is assigned 10 or more deaths in Ukrainian official counts.

statement: Between 2026-08-30 and 2026-11-30, the US and Iranian governments both publicly confirm a specific round of direct or mediated negotiations, with venue or date named.
resolution: The US State Department or White House and the Iranian foreign ministry each publicly confirm a negotiation round with named venue or date occurring between 2026-08-30 and 2026-11-30, per two international outlets.
failure_condition: By 2026-11-30 no negotiation round with named venue or date has been publicly confirmed by both governments.

statement: Between 2026-09-01 and 2026-11-30, an attack on or seizure of a commercial vessel in the Strait of Hormuz or Gulf of Oman is publicly logged by UKMTO or CENTCOM.
resolution: A UKMTO advisory or CENTCOM release documents an attack on or seizure of a commercial vessel in the Strait of Hormuz or Gulf of Oman occurring between 2026-09-01 and 2026-11-30.
failure_condition: UKMTO and CENTCOM public records through the deadline contain no such incident dated within the window.

statement: By 2026-10-30, the combined official confirmed death toll from the August 2026 Nepal-Tibet glacial outburst floods, per Nepali and Chinese authorities, reaches at least 1,000.
resolution: AP, Reuters, AFP, or BBC report official Nepali plus Chinese confirmed-dead figures for the August 2026 flood totaling 1,000 or more, dated on or before 2026-10-30.
failure_condition: The latest official combined confirmed toll reported on or before 2026-10-30 stands below 1,000.

statement: A PaperCut vulnerability is added to the CISA KEV catalog with a dateAdded value between 2026-08-29 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog JSON contains at least one entry naming PaperCut with dateAdded between 2026-08-29 and 2026-09-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: The KEV catalog fetched at the deadline contains no PaperCut entry with dateAdded inside the window.

statement: The HHS OCR breach portal lists a filing by McKesson or a McKesson subsidiary, submitted between 2026-08-01 and 2026-11-30, covering 500 or more individuals.
resolution: The HHS OCR breach portal shows an entry naming McKesson or a subsidiary with report date between 2026-08-01 and 2026-11-30 and individuals affected of 500 or more.
failure_condition: The portal at the deadline contains no qualifying McKesson-linked entry with a report date inside the window.

statement: The FOMC statement of 2026-09-16 leaves the federal funds target range at or above the pre-meeting range of 3.50 to 3.75 percent.
resolution: The Federal Reserve statement and implementation note dated 2026-09-16 show a target range equal to or higher than 3.50 to 3.75 percent.
failure_condition: The 2026-09-16 statement sets a target range below 3.50 to 3.75 percent.

statement: ICE Brent crude front-month futures settle at or above 95.00 USD per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-09-01 and 2026-11-27.
resolution: Official ICE Brent front-month daily settlement prices show at least one settlement at or above 95.00 USD between 2026-09-01 and 2026-11-27.
failure_condition: Every ICE Brent front-month settlement between 2026-09-01 and 2026-11-27 is below 95.00 USD.

statement: Between 2026-08-29 and 2026-11-30, Treasury OFAC publishes a new or amended Venezuela general license authorizing petroleum-sector transactions.
resolution: The OFAC Venezuela sanctions page carries a general license, new or amended, dated between 2026-08-29 and 2026-11-30, whose text authorizes petroleum-sector transactions.
failure_condition: No general license meeting the description with an issue date inside the window appears on the OFAC site.

statement: Between 2026-08-29 and 2026-10-31, US authorities remove Milo Yiannopoulos from the United States.
resolution: Two international outlets, citing DHS, ICE, or court records, report Yiannopoulos removed or deported from the US on a date between 2026-08-29 and 2026-10-31.
failure_condition: Yiannopoulos remains in the United States, whether detained or released, through 2026-10-31.
